faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about starting global fulfillment with VietGlobal.
faq.q1: Do I need to hold inventory?
faq.a1: No. For POD and dropshipping models, products are produced or sourced on demand after customer orders. For brands holding inventory, we offer scalable warehousing.
faq.q2: Which markets can you ship to today?
faq.a2: Our core routes span Southeast Asia, the Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia), European Union countries, the UK, and the United States.
faq.q3: How does POD fulfillment pricing work?
faq.a3: Pricing consists of the product blank/manufacturing cost + printing/handling fee + international shipping rate. All rates are transparent with no hidden costs.
faq.q4: Can I use my own branding on packaging?
faq.a4: Yes, absolutely. We support custom poly mailers, branded stickers, neck labels, and personalized thank-you cards.
faq.q5: How long does cross-border delivery usually take?
faq.a5: Direct line express cross-border delivery typically takes between 5 to 8 business days depending on destination market.
faq.q6: Which platforms do you integrate with?
faq.a6: We integrate directly with Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, WooCommerce, and Etsy with automatic order & tracking sync.
faq.q7: What does VietGlobal's Omnichannel Store Operations service include?
faq.a7: We offer complete end-to-end management: store creation & decoration, SEO-optimized listings, real-time multi-platform inventory sync, ad campaigns & promotions, and 24/7 customer chat support & dispute resolution, allowing you to scale revenue without heavy internal staffing.
